name: mirrorfield
description: 镜原 Mirrorfield - 草原镜林对战游戏

scripts.prepare:www: mkdir -p www && cp index.html manifest.json sw.js icon.svg www/
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init "镜原 Mirrorfield" com.mirrorfield.game --web-dir www
scripts.cap:add:android: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npm run prepare:www && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.build:ios: npm run prepare:www && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
